note: Industries the government is pushing, mapped to NSE basic industries. A theme to know about, not a buy signal. MSME = last full-year sales up to Rs 500 cr (the medium-enterprise turnover limit).

themes.name: Pharma ingredients (APIs)
themes.why: India imports billions of dollars of APIs, bulk drugs and intermediates; the PM asked pharma to build plants to make them at home.

themes.name: Special steel grades
themes.why: India exports iron ore but imports finished steel; industry asked to make the imported grades here.

themes.name: Aluminium alloys and minerals value-add
themes.why: Large bauxite reserves but specialised aluminium alloys are imported; more processing of minerals inside India.

themes.name: Agri and food processing exports
themes.why: India's share of world farm exports is only 2-2.5%; companies asked to invest in agriculture, procurement and processed food for export.

themes.name: Tools and engineering goods
themes.why: India's share of world hand-tool and power-tool exports is small; large firms asked to help small firms build quality and scale.

themes.name: Machinery for the Global South
themes.why: Packaging equipment, irrigation systems and factory machinery for developing countries.
